purpose: Private Middleware /metrics scrape contract and the V3 command-kernel metric expectations Prometheus will collect, with a closed low-cardinality label policy. Middleware never becomes a telemetry database; Prometheus owns collection, storage and query.

v3_candidate_observed.authority: informational only; unmerged, owned by the Middleware V3 session

scrape_contract.scheme: http (private Docker network only; TLS terminates nowhere public)

edge_behavior.caddy: GET /metrics answers 404 ahead of Kong and the legacy fallback (Codestra-Caddy integration/kong-edge-20260919 @ 1a34d9d)
edge_behavior.kong: no route publishes /metrics; monitoring-readonly reaches Middleware on the private network only

evidence_at_prep_base.canonical_api: app/appolon_routes.py: GET /metrics verifies client monitoring-readonly + scope metrics.read as its first statement (proved by scripts/validate_staging_intake_observability_contract.py)
evidence_at_prep_base.declared_contract: contracts/staging-intake-observability-runtime.v1.json: {GET /metrics, client monitoring-readonly, scope metrics.read, audience middleware-api, public_exposure false}
evidence_at_prep_base.narrow_runtimes: app/entrypoints/runtime.py mounts prometheus_client make_asgi_app() at /metrics for worker and narrow-service processes WITHOUT bearer verification (guarded() covers /api/ and /v1/ only) - PRIVATE_REQUIRED; V3 expectation: authenticate or keep strictly network-private

scrape_contract.metric_relabel_guard: labeldrop of every forbidden label below on the codestra-middleware-metrics job

bounded_extension_observed_on_v3_candida.stage: kernel stage of middleware_command_duration_seconds (closed enum in the V3 kernel)
bounded_extension_observed_on_v3_candida.reason: policy / safety denial reason code (closed enum; never free text)
bounded_extension_observed_on_v3_candida.operation: adapter operation name (closed enum per adapter)
bounded_extension_observed_on_v3_candida.dependency: required dependency name (closed enum: postgres, redis, nats, openbao, keycloak, kong, adapter ids)

label_policy.rule: every label value set must be a closed enum known at build time; identifiers, personal data and free text are never labels (they remain structured log fields or trace attributes)

expected_metrics.name: commands_completed_total
expected_metrics.help: Commands completed after a matched readback

expected_metrics.name: idempotency_duplicates_total
expected_metrics.help: Exact replays answered from the ledger

expected_metrics.name: outbox_oldest_seconds
expected_metrics.help: Age of the oldest pending outbox row

expected_metrics.name: adapter_failures_total
expected_metrics.help: Adapter invocations that did not acknowledge

expected_metrics.name: dead_letters_total
expected_metrics.help: Dead-lettered outbox rows (the V3 candidate exposes a gauge; the mission names a counter - reconcile the name at re-pin)

expected_metrics.name: dependency_health
expected_metrics.help: 1 when a required dependency (postgres, redis, nats, openbao, keycloak, adapters) is healthy; name PENDING - the V3 candidate exposes dependency health through /health/ready and the readiness collector today

observed_at_prep_base.note: metric names exposed by Middleware at the prep base that the V3 names will supersede or complement

prepared_rules.why_dark: codestra/compose.yaml mounts only codestra/prometheus/rules; the prepared directory is validated but not evaluated until V3_FINAL_SHA is pinned and the file is moved into codestra/prometheus/rules/ by the owner
activation_steps: Confirm every v3_candidate_name and label set against the frozen V3 tree; update this contract
